series.name: PK retailer extras (AYS + BijliBazar) — not on official table
series.notes: E8/F0/F5/F10 appear on both AYS and BijliBazar PK tables but NOT on the official Haier PK master table — kept separate for provenance.

title.en: Indoor fan motor or PCB error
title.ur: Indoor fan motor ya PCB kharabi

meaning.en: Indoor fan drive fault — motor or control board reported abnormal operation.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan drive fault — motor ya control board ne ghair mamooli kaam kiya.

causes.en: Indoor fan motor or its driver circuit fault
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor ya uska driver circuit kharab

solutions.ur: motor/PCB connection tait kr ke check karein

solutions.en: Replace faulty motor or board under service
solutions.ur: service ke under kharab motor ya board badlein

source.title: AYS Online Haier AC error codes (+ BijliBazar agreement)

notes.en: Present on both AYS and BijliBazar PK tables; NOT on official Haier PK table. hvacinexpert "E8=compressor overload" conflicts and is quarantined.
notes.ur: AYS aur BijliBazar PK dono tables mein maujood hai; official Haier PK table par nahi. hvacinexpert ki "E8=compressor overload" wali baat conflict karti hai aur use quarantine kiya gaya hai.

meaning.en: Charge low enough to flag F0 (may not display on all models).
meaning.ur: gas charge itni kam hai ke F0 aa jaye (har model par nahin aata)

causes.ur: adhory service ke baad kam charge system

solutions.en: Technician finds and fixes the leak, then recharges
solutions.ur: technician leak dhoond kar theek kare, phir gas bharwayein

solutions.en: Clean coils while recharging to protect the system
solutions.ur: gas bharne waqt coils bhi saaf karein taake system ki hifazat ho

notes.en: Both PK retailers agree; not on official table (official uses F13 for lack of refrigerant).
notes.ur: Dono PK retailers agree karte hain; official table par nahi (official mein refrigerant kam hone par F13 use hota hai).

meaning.en: Outdoor fan motor failed or feedback abnormal (distinct from F8 DC fan code on official list).
meaning.ur: outdoor fan motor kharab ya feedback ghair mamooli (official list ke F8 se alag)

causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor ki winding ya bearing kharab

solutions.en: Check motor and replace if not running freely
solutions.ur: motor check karein, aazad na chale to badlein

solutions.en: Inspect wiring and PCB fan output
solutions.ur: wiring aur PCB fn output check karein

notes.en: Not on official PK table; keep separate from official F8.
notes.ur: Official PK table par nahi hai; official F8 se alag rakhein.

meaning.en: Current-sensor reading invalid (may not display on all models).
meaning.ur: current sensor ki reading gair durust (har model par nahin aata)

causes.en: Current sensor or its wiring faulty
causes.ur: current sensor ya is ki wiring kharab

solutions.en: Check sensor and wiring; replace sensor if bad
solutions.ur: sensor aur wiring check karein, kharab ho to sensor badlein

solutions.en: Service escalates to PCB if sensor tests good
solutions.ur: sensor theek nikle to service PCB tak jaye

notes.en: Also appears in Japan Electronics F-list narrative; not on official table (F24 is official CT abnormal).
notes.ur: Japan Electronics F-list ki narrative mein bhi aata hai; official table par nahi (official mein CT abnormal ke liye F24 hai).
